    StartersVal and Earl's truck jerkySoy and Worcestershire jerky. You guys know how to pole vault?How to make it600g beef topside60ml soy sauce2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp cracked black pepperSlice the beef thin across the grain.Marinate with the soy, Worcestershire, sugar and pepper overnight in the fridge.Dry on racks in a low oven with the door ajar until leathery.Chang's Market spiced nuts and cracklingPork crackling with chilli salt, plus honey cayenne roasted peanutsHow to make it600g pork rind2 tsp salt flakes1 tsp chilli flakes250g raw peanuts1 tbsp honey1 tsp cayenne pepper1 tbsp vegetable oilScore the pork rind finely, rub with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge.Pat dry and roast at 230°C until blistered and crisp. Break into pieces and toss with chilli salt.Toss the peanuts with the honey, cayenne, salt and oil.Roast at 180°C, stirring once.Nachos with jalapeño cheese sauceWalter Chang names them graboids. He's got rights.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRump, sausages, beans and slawGrilled rump and sausages with molasses baked beans and creamy cabbage slawHow to make it800g baked beans (2 tins)1 onion, diced2 tbsp molasses1/4 cabbage100g mayonnaise1 tbsp white vinegar2 rump steaks4 thick beef sausagesSimmer the baked beans with the onion and molasses.Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and vinegar.Grill the rump steaks and sausages over hot coals.Slice the meat to share.Burt's bunker franks and beansTinned franks and beans, five years' worth.How to make itAs written, serves 4Smoky franks browned and simmered with onion, beans, molasses, mustard and smoked paprika until thick and glossy, with warm buttered cornbread.Slice 8 franks into coins and brown in a pot with 1 tbsp oil.Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes.Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp American mustard and 2 tbsp tomato paste.Add 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans and 250ml stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick.Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200°C for 20 minutes.SweetsChocolate pudding dirt cupsChocolate pudding, cookie crumbs, gummy graboids.How to make it600ml full cream milk80g caster sugar3 tbsp cocoa3 tbsp cornflour100g chocolate biscuits, crushed1 bag gummy wormsWhisk the milk, sugar, cocoa and cornflour in a pot over medium heat until thick.Pour into four cups and chill.Top with crushed biscuit and push gummy worms in so they poke out.DrinksVal and Earl's bourbon iced teaHoney sweetened iced tea with bourbon, peach and lemonHow to make it4 black tea bags800ml boiling water4 tbsp honey1 peach2 lemons180ml bourbon1 bag iceBrew the tea bags in the boiling water, remove, and stir in the honey.Cool and chill.Slice the peach and one lemon. Fill four jars with ice and the slices.Add bourbon to each, top with the tea, stir and serve with a squeeze of lemon.Cold longneck beerBurt's toast: broke into the wrong rec room.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
